title: Multi-section account registration — Harvest Lane grocery delivery
notes: v1 is a Bootstrap 5 form with four numbered fieldsets. v2 is a Next.js rewrite with CSS-module class names (Field_label__xxxxx), React useId ids (':r6:') and react-hook-form style names (confirmPassword, address.state, acceptTerms). Sections are reordered (login details first, email moved out of 'Personal information'), the address row becomes ZIP / City / State, and the marketing opt-in now precedes the terms checkbox. The password rules list moves into a <hl-password-rules> declarative shadow root. Decoys: a promo bar email form above the header, a second password input next to the confirmation, a sticky mobile 'Create account' bar and an aria-live announcer that repeats the 'Passwords don't match' error.
